الإعلانات مزعجة وتقتل المتعة و اللعبة حذفتها اكثر من مره بسبب الإعلانات وفي كل دقيقة يخرج اعلان واضطر للخروج من اللعبة ودخولة مرة اخرى، وفي كل شي انجزه يطلع لي اعلان وفي كل وقت اتمنى فعلا ان تسمعون الملاحظات الكثيره بسبب الإعلانات وتحذفونها من اللعبة لانها مزعجة جداً جداً جداً وفقط .

reviews.title: A non-helping support center
reviews.text: I love the game and I’ve been playing it for years since I was 13, but two days ago my account in the game that reached around 374 stars, level 8 and 324 filmed movies have started itself again from level 1 and stars 1 as if I’ve never played ever. When I contacted the support about my problem, the bot support didn’t help me at all. I tried contacting multiple times from multiple places like the support from inside the game itself and the support of the formal website of Tamatem but yet still I haven’t got a single useful respond from the game support and I have got no respond from the website support till now. Even though my problem is a problem that the game support can solve, but yet not helped at all. I hope that the game supporters take my problem seriously and try to help me solve it because I was so sad to lose my whole effort and still sad till now.
